title: Should you use AI in your job search? 🔎
description:
The job search doesn't seem to be getting any easier and it sounds like it just getting harder at this point…so is there a place for AI in your job search? Yes.

You *SHOULDN’T take the results as final but no one likes staring at a blank resume or application. Use tools like ChatGPT to get those ideas going. New resume achievements. New cover letter. LinkedIn profile material. The use cases are endless. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #chatgpt #chatgpt4 #resumetips #jobapplication
